### Holly Dash (G4)

**Who she is.** A fleeting *Friendship Is Magic* background **unicorn mare** with a pale-pink coat, yellow–blue–purple mane and tail, blue eyes in merchandise/comics, and a **strawberry cutie mark**. She is a ponysona/cameo of animator **Holly Giesbrecht**, not an alternate identity of Rainbow Dash. [Character guide](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Holly_Dash)

**How she got her name.** A 2011 comment attributed to Giesbrecht says coworkers nicknamed *her* “Holly Dash” because of her colorful hair; she used it for her pony. The show never says her name, but **Holly Dash** later appeared on Hasbro toys/cards. **Tutti Frutti** was an early *fan nickname*, not the merchandise name. [Naming history](https://tropedia.fandom.com/wiki/My_Little_Pony:_Friendship_Is_Magic/Characters/Background_Ponies) In Gameloft’s game, she was initially labeled **Chatty Schoolteacher**, then renamed Holly Dash; that label does not establish a teaching job in the TV series. [Gameloft character entry](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Holly_Dash)

**Where to spot her.** She briefly bows in the crowd at the end of **S1E2, “Friendship Is Magic, Part 2”**, and runs through parasprite-stricken Ponyville in **S1E10, “Swarm of the Century.”** She also appears in IDW *Friendship Is Magic* **#7** (p. 2) and *Micro-Series* **#8** (p. 5). **Speaking:** no verified spoken TV dialogue or credited voice actor; her **“Flighty Filly”** title and printed dialogue belong to the collectible card game, not a voiced scene. [Official CCG card reference](https://abcdocz.com/doc/1164462/my-little-pony-collectible-card-game-official-card-reference)
